appendText: “The public likes and needs simple messages. I don’t think this differentiation is going to change anything,” she said. Dr. Robert Kushner, of the Northwestern Feinberg School of Medicine, said changing the definition of obesity will take some time. Kushner, a co-writer of the report, said, “This is the first step in the process. I think it’s going to begin the conversation.” I’m John Russell.
